transcript.en: Good morning.
transcript.zh: 早上好

transcript.en: How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 我能为你做什么

transcript.en: Hello. I'm interested in renting a house somewhere in the town.
transcript.zh: 你好。我想在小镇里租一个房子。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Could I have your name please?
transcript.zh: 可以告诉我你的名字吗

transcript.en: Yes, it's Steven Godfrey.
transcript.zh: 我叫史蒂文·戈弗雷

transcript.en: And tell me how many bedrooms you're looking for.
transcript.zh: 告诉我，你想要几个房间。

transcript.en: Well, we'd need four, because I'm going to share the house with three friends.
transcript.zh: 我需要四个房间，因为我要和我的三个朋友一起住。

transcript.en: Okay, there are several of that size on our books.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们的名册上有几套这样的房子。

transcript.en: They mostly belong to families who are working abroad at the moment.
transcript.zh: 它们多数属于此刻在海外工作的家庭

transcript.en: What about the location?
transcript.zh: 那么地点呢

transcript.en: It'd be nice to be central.
transcript.zh: 最好是小镇中心

transcript.en: That might be difficult, as most houses of that size are in the suburbs.
transcript.zh: 这有点难，多数这种面积的房子都在郊区。

transcript.en: Still, there are a few.
transcript.zh: 但是仍然有几个

transcript.en: What's your upper limit for the rent?
transcript.zh: 你的租房上限是多少

transcript.en: We'd like something around ￡500 a month, but we could go up to ￡600 if we have to.
transcript.zh: 我们希望一个月在500英镑左右，但是如果有必要的话，我们最多可以出到600英镑。

transcript.en: But we can't go beyond that.
transcript.zh: 但是再多就不行了

transcript.en: Do you know how long you want to rent the house for?
transcript.zh: 你知道要租多久吗

transcript.en: The minimum let is six months, as you probably realise.
transcript.zh: 你可能已经知道了，最小期限是6个月。

transcript.en: We're at college here for two years, and we don't want to have to move during that time if we can avoid it.
transcript.zh: 我们在这里上两年大学，如果可以的话，我们在这期间不想搬家。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: And how soon do you want to move in?
transcript.zh: 你们想多快入住

transcript.en: All our lets start on the first of the month.
transcript.zh: 我们所有的租赁从月初开始

transcript.en: Well, as soon as possible, really, so that means September 1st.
transcript.zh: 尽快，所以是9月1日。

transcript.en: Okay, let me have a look at what we've got...
transcript.zh: 好的，让我们看看这些房子……

transcript.en: We have photographs of all the houses on our books, so you can get an idea of what they're like.
transcript.zh: 我们的名册上有所有这些房子的照片，所以你可以了解一下它们的样子。

transcript.en: There's this one in Oakington Avenue, at ￡550 a month.
transcript.zh: 这座在奥金顿大街，每月550英镑，

transcript.en: Combined living room and dining room, with a separate kitchen.
transcript.zh: 其中包括客厅、餐厅和独立厨房。

transcript.en: It doesn't have a garage, though you can park in the road.
transcript.zh: 这里没有车库，但是你可以停在路边。

transcript.en: Ah, we'd prefer to have one, if possible.
transcript.zh: 如果可以的话，我们希望有一个。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Then have a look at this house, in Mead Street.
transcript.zh: 看看这个在米德街的房子

transcript.en: It's got a very large living room and kitchen, bathroom, cloakroom...
transcript.zh: 它有一个很大的客厅、厨房、浴室和衣帽间……

transcript.en: How much is it?
transcript.zh: 这个多少钱

transcript.en: That one's 580.
transcript.zh: 580英镑

transcript.en: It's very well furnished and equipped.
transcript.zh: 精装修、设施齐全。

transcript.en: It also has plenty of space for parking, and it's available for a minimum of a year.
transcript.zh: 停车位多，至少可以使用一年。

transcript.en: Oh, and there's a big garden.
transcript.zh: 还有一个大花园

transcript.en: I don't think we could cope with that, to be honest.
transcript.zh: 老实说，我觉得我们没办法应付它。

transcript.en: We'll be too busy to look after it.
transcript.zh: 我们太忙了，无法照顾它。

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Then there's this older house in Hamilton Road: living room, kitchen-diner, and it has a study.
transcript.zh: 有一个老一点的房子在哈密尔顿路，它包括客厅，大厨房和书房

transcript.en: 550 a month.
transcript.zh: 550英镑一个月

transcript.en: That looks rather nice.
transcript.zh: 这个看起来不错

transcript.en: But whereabouts in Hamilton Road?
transcript.zh: 但是它在哈密尔顿路的哪儿

transcript.en: Towards the western end.
transcript.zh: 一直到西边的尽头

transcript.en: Oh, that'll be very noisy.
transcript.zh: 那里非常吵，我知道那里，

transcript.en: I know the area.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: Yes, it's pretty lively.
transcript.zh: 很热闹

transcript.en: Some people like it, though.
transcript.zh: 但是有些人喜欢那里

transcript.en: Well, what about this house in Devon Close?
transcript.zh: 这个在德文郡的房子怎么样

transcript.en: That looks lovely.
transcript.zh: 这个很好

transcript.en: There's a big demand for houses in that area, so prices tend to be quite high.
transcript.zh: 这一地区的房子很抢手，所以价格往往很高。

transcript.en: But this one hasn't been decorated for a few years, which has kept the rent down a bit.
transcript.zh: 但是这套多年来都没有装修过，所以房租要低一点点。

transcript.en: It's got a living room, dining room and small kitchen, and it's 595 a month.
transcript.zh: 它有一个客厅、餐厅和小厨房，一个月595英镑。

transcript.en: I think it would suit you, from what you've said.
transcript.zh: 根据你的要求，我觉得这个适合你，

transcript.en: It sounds fine.
transcript.zh: 听起来很好。

transcript.en: Why's that part of town so popular?
transcript.zh: 为什么小镇的那片地区很受欢迎？

transcript.en: Well, there's a big scheme to improve the district, and it'll soon have the best facilities for miles around.
transcript.zh: 有一个发展该区的大计划，不久在方圆几英里内将会有最完备的设施。

transcript.en: What sort of thing?
transcript.zh: 什么样的东西？

transcript.en: There's a big sports centre under construction, which will be very impressive when it's finished.
transcript.zh: 有一个大型体育中心正在建设，建完后将非常引人注目，

transcript.en: In fact the swimming pool's already opened, ahead of schedule, and it's attracting a lot of people.
transcript.zh: 事实上，游泳池已经提前运营了，并且吸引了很多人。

transcript.en: What about cinemas: are there any in the area?
transcript.zh: 那么电影院呢，那里有吗？

transcript.en: The only one closed down last year, and it's now in the process of being converted into a film museum.
transcript.zh: 唯一一个去年关闭了，现在正在将它变为电影博物馆。

transcript.en: The local people are trying to get a new cinema added to the scheme.
transcript.zh: 当地人正在试图将建设新电影院加到计划中去

transcript.en: I think I heard something about a plan to replace the existing concert hall with a larger one.
transcript.zh: 我想我听说有一个计划是要用更大的音乐厅替换现在的这座

transcript.en: Ah, that's due to start next year.
transcript.zh: 那个预计在明年开始

transcript.en: Well it sounds an interesting area to live in.
transcript.zh: 听起来是一个很好的居住地点

transcript.en: Could I go and see the house, please?
transcript.zh: 请问我能去看看房子吗

transcript.en: Yes, of course.
transcript.zh: 当然
